notes: Three fixes. Saving a clip now works — the button was asking the server for the file without signing the request, so it came back as “your session expired”. Tapping mute, comment, Crush or Share on a playing clip no longer fast-forwards it: holding the picture still runs it at 2×, but a tap is just a tap. And a big video no longer closes the app at the start of compression — the phone now gets its video memory back before compressing, and if it runs out it says so instead of disappearing.
